steps.en: Hand your agent one URL — the project's install doc — and nothing else
steps.zh: 把一个 URL（项目的安装文档）交给你的 Agent，别的不用管

steps.en: Install the CLI, then check the machine read-only and list what's missing
steps.zh: 装好 CLI，默认只读体检机器，列出缺失项

steps.en: Approve system-level installs explicitly when you want the tools actually installed
steps.zh: 确认可改机器后，再显式授权系统级安装

steps.en: Install the vetted upstream CLI/MCP per platform, each as an ordered primary+fallback list
steps.zh: 按平台装好选定的上游工具，每个平台是一份首选加备选的有序清单

steps.en: For logged-in platforms, just ask your agent to configure that platform and export cookies when guided
steps.zh: 要登录态的平台，对 Agent 说「帮我配 Twitter」即可

steps.en: agent-reach doctor probes each channel for real and reports which backend is currently active
steps.zh: doctor 逐通道真实探测，报告当前生效的后端

value.en: Your agent reads and searches Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu via upstream tools — when a path dies, the stack swaps it, zero action
value.zh: Agent 经上游工具读取和搜索各大平台；某条接入路失效，栈自己换代，你零操作
